title: Apple expects its highest revenue yet in Q4, but memory prices will hurt profits
description: During an earnings call on November 2, the company's CFO Kevan Parekh said that Apple is expecting Q4 this year to be the best quarter in the history of the company in terms of revenue. The fiscal Q4 2026 (ending in September) results point to a very optimistic near future for the company, despite the supply chain constraints, rising component prices and inventory shortages. The forecast comes amid Apple's record-breaking numbers reported in Q3 2026. title: Tipster brings bad news for the Galaxy Z Fold9 and Z Fold9 Ultra cameras
description: The Galaxy Z Fold9 models may bring back the under-display camera next year, but that might be the only camera upgrade they get. Tipster Lanzuk has scoured various sources and claims that the 2027 wide and book-style foldables will retain the same “rear” cameras as their predecessors. The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold9 Ultra will have a 200MP main camera, a 50MP ultra-wide and it will “maintain 3x optical zoom”. Now, that last detail comes with no megapixel count attached, but what are the chances of an upgrade from the current 10MP module when even the new S27 Pro is only getting a 3x 12MP...

title: Android and iOS apps will be able to bypass the share sheet next year
description: Quick Share has come a long way over the past year. It started working with Apple's AirDrop on Pixels, then that support began spreading to other Android phones, and in August Google launched Tap to Share. Now, the company is going to let developers build Quick Share directly into their own apps - and not just on Android. At its Android Dev Summit, Google announced a Quick Share SDK that will be released in the first half of 2027, along with a Quick Share iOS SDK for iPhone apps. Apps that adopt it will let you send files to nearby devices without going through the system share sheet and...

title: RedMagic 12 Pro review
iPhone Duo shortages will continue for the foreseeable future, Apple CEO says
description: Apple's first foldable, the iPhone Duo, sold out within hours of pre-orders opening on October 16, and shipping dates quickly slipped all the way to January. Ahead of launch day, the company also warned of limited walk-in stock in its stores. Now, if you were hoping things would get better soon, Apple's CEO has some bad news for you. [#InlinePriceWidget,13804,1#] Speaking yesterday, after Apple reported record results for its September quarter, John Ternus said the Duo "is constrained as of today". He added that the production ramp is going well, but that the company can't predict when...

title: iPhone Duo's woes are a boon for Samsung as Galaxy Z Fold8 sales go up by 20% in a week
description: Reports of spotty quality assurance and breaking displays have scared off some potential iPhone Duo buyers and driven them into Samsung’s arms – a report from South Korea states that Galaxy Z Fold8 sales increased by more than 20% in a week after the Duo started shipping. Something similar happened back in September when the Duo was unveiled – Z Fold8 sales went up by 10% on a week-to-week basis after people finally saw Apple’s fabled first foldable (and its price). Samsung is moving to seize the moment by extending the subscription period for the New AI Subscription Club by a month...

title: Samsung Galaxy A58's charging speed revealed by 3C certification
description: The Samsung Galaxy A58 is expected to arrive in March or April next year. While its exact launch date is unknown, China's 3C certification has revealed its charging speed. The Samsung Galaxy A58, which has received 3C certification, has model code SM-A5860 and supports 45W charging (10V/4.5A or 15V/3A), the same as its predecessor, the Galaxy A57. The 3C certificate also revealed that the Galaxy A58 will be sold without a charger in China. title: Honor's 14,000mAh smartphone battery can reportedly last a week
description: Back in June, a tipster claimed that Honor was developing a smartphone with a massive 14,000mAh battery. At the time, the battery was reportedly in the New Product Introduction (NPI) stage. A new leak now suggests that the battery has entered mass production. According to tipster Digital Chat Station, the battery will have a capacity of between 14,000mAh and 15,000mAh and has reportedly entered the trial production phase. title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra's dummy unit surfaces
description: CAD-based renders of the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra that leaked in August revealed its design. Now, the source of those renders has built a dummy unit of the S27 Ultra from the CAD files and compared it with the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, Apple iPhone 18 Pro, and Google Pixel 11 Pro. The Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra's dummy unit doesn't have real weight, and since it's a dummy unit, it also lacks a display, a battery, or anything else inside. title: Realme 17T design revealed in leaked live images
description: Late last month, a leak revealed the specifications of the upcoming Realme 17 Pro series. Now, a fresh leak has surfaced, offering a first look at the design of another expected model in the lineup, the Realme 17T. The leaked images offer a look at the front and rear design of the alleged Realme 17T. From the front, the phone appears largely identical to the outgoing Realme 16T, although the display bezels seem slightly slimmer, particularly along the bottom edge. The rear, however, gets a more noticeable design overhaul with an updated camera module that bears a strong...

title: Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm leaks: expect a big increase in battery capacity
description: It has been months since Xiaomi launched the 46mm Xiaomi Watch S5. Now, a leak reveals the specs of an upcoming 41mm version of the watch. The S-series runs a proprietary version of HyperOS instead of Wear OS, which means fewer features but longer runtime. The Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm has a stainless steel body that is slightly thicker than its predecessor, the Xiaomi Watch S4 41mm, at 9.9mm (up from 9.5mm). The upside of this is the sizable increase in battery capacity to 590mAh. That is close to double the 320mAh capacity of the S4 41mm. The battery will last up to 8 days of normal use or up...

title: Samsung's upgraded sleep apnea feature is now available on the Galaxy Ring and Watch9
description: Last week Samsung announced that the upgraded version of its sleep apnea feature was approved in Korea, following its FDA clearance in the US back in July. Today, the company has announced that the new version has become available in the US, including for the Galaxy Ring, which Samsung says is the first smart ring with an FDA-cleared, over-the-counter sleep apnea risk detection feature. The original version of the function, which received De Novo authorization from the FDA in February 2024, could only tell you whether signs of moderate to severe sleep apnea were detected. The upgraded one...

title: RedMagic 12 Pro brings its RGB liquid cooling and 185Hz screen to the global market
description: Back in mid-October, the RedMagic 12 Pro+ was unveiled in China, and RedMagic said at the time that it would also launch globally as the RedMagic 12 Pro. Today, the RedMagic 12 Pro is official for the rest of the world, and it keeps the RGB-lit liquid cooling and the 8,400 mAh battery of its Chinese counterpart. That battery is 12% bigger than the 7,500 mAh cell in the RedMagic 11 Pro, yet the new handset is thinner, at 8.5mm (vs. 8.9mm). Charging is where the global model differs from the Chinese one - you get 80W wired charging instead of 120W, along with wireless and bypass...

title: Apple reports record quarter - iPhone and Mac sales are up, Services reach an all-time high
description: Apple announced a record $114.5 billion in revenue for the three months ending in September (which is Apple’s fiscal Q4) with a gross margin of 47.9%. Revenue is up 12% year-over-year and earnings per share are up 14% to $2.10. Tariff refunds helped boost Apple’s numbers by $0.05 per share and 1 percentage point for the gross margin. For fiscal 2026 (the twelve months ending in September), Apple posted a record-breaking revenue of $479 billion with a double-digit growth in earnings per share. title: vivo V80 FE listed online with Dimensity 7400-Turbo SoC and 7,000mAh battery
description: The vivo V80 debuted in global markets last month, and the company now appears to be gearing up to launch the V80 FE. The upcoming smartphone has surfaced on vivo’s official Philippines website, hinting at an imminent launch. vivo has also revealed the V80 FE's full specifications via the official online listing. The phone retains a design similar to the standard V80 but features one fewer rear camera. It’s powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7400-Turbo chipset, paired with up to 8GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 256GB of UFS 3.1 storage. The phone features a 6.59-inch AMOLED display with up...

title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro and S27 Ultra to feature an upgraded Privacy Display
description: Samsung launched the Galaxy S26 Ultra earlier this year with a Privacy Display feature, and next year's Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra are rumored to have it, too. A new report by SamMobile corroborates those rumors and claims these two S27 series smartphones will feature an upgraded version of Privacy Display. The source also says that the Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra will have enhanced display brightness, making their screens easier to read under direct sunlight. title: Oppo Reno17 and Reno17 Pro's specs, colors, and configurations leak
description: Oppo recently confirmed that the Reno17 series will launch in China this month. Ahead of the debut, a new leak has revealed the key specs, color options, and the configurations of the Reno17 and Reno17 Pro. In a now edited post on Weibo, tipster Digital Chat Station shared new details about the upcoming Oppo Reno17 series. According to the tipster, both models in the lineup will feature a 50MP periscope telephoto camera. title: Elon Musk's SpaceX may buy Boost Mobile to make Starlink into a full-fledged carrier
description: SpaceX has made no secret of its plans to turn Starlink Mobile into a full-fledged US carrier, and last month it bought more spectrum to help make that happen. What it still lacks is a ground network, and last week T-Mobile's CEO ruled out letting Starlink Mobile run on his company's network. Now, according to a new report, Elon Musk may have found a way around that problem, and it's called Boost Mobile. title: OnePlus Turbo 7 key specs leak, and it's a big step up
description: OnePlus launched the Turbo 6 in China back in January, and now a tipster on Weibo has shared the first details about its successor. According to the source, the Turbo 7 will be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 6, which is still being refined, and OnePlus is allegedly vying to be among the first to launch a phone with it. The Turbo 7 is also said to continue OnePlus' push to bring a 200MP main camera and a 185Hz refresh rate (165Hz system-wide) to more of its phones. title: Motorola Signature 27 stars in hands-on promo video ahead of launch
description: While we wait for Motorola to fully take the wraps off the Signature 27, its next flagship smartphone, the company has partnered up with Danny Winget for an exclusive hands-on promo video showcasing the device in all its glory. You can see it below. The Signature 27 is confirmed to come in two colors, Pantone Coal Smoke and Pantone Capulet Olive, and to have Audio by Bang & Olufsen, as the company previously announced.
